description: Remote capability for the main window when it shows the dashboard served at the loopback XOKSA origin (127.0.0.1:8787). This origin carries attacker-influenceable content (news, LLM output), so it is least-privilege: ONLY the two windowing/link commands plus the event channel needed to receive a brushed chart interval / help pick from the popup windows. No core:default, no filesystem, shell, http, or window/path operations.
